title: The grandson's trial
summary: The boy you gave the old man's 1971 scarf to is fourteen now and on trial at the academy. He's wearing the scarf to it, in May.

ends.title: The scarf signed
ends.text: The boy with the 1971 scarf signed for the academy. He hangs it on his peg.

ends.title: In the stand
ends.text: The boy with the 1971 scarf wasn't kept on. He's in his grandad's seat every home game.

beats.title: In May

event.title: In May
event.speaker: fan
setup: The academy pitches, a Wednesday in May. A boy of fourteen in boots too big for him and a woollen scarf that's older than his dad. It's the scarf from 1971.

say: {coach.short} sees you looking. "Not bad, that one. Bit scared. Know him?"

replies.label: Go and say something to the boy.
"No. Judge him on what he does."

know.text: You tell {coach.short} about the old man in the seat by the tunnel. He doesn't say anything. He watches the boy for the rest of the session.

talk.text: You tell him his grandad said 1971 was the best day of his life. The boy scores twice in the second half.

leave.text: The boy has a quiet game. He looks up at the stand once, at the seat by the tunnel.

beats.hint: The boy with the 1971 scarf is on trial

beats.title: His peg

event.title: His peg
event.speaker: fan
setup: A season on. The academy dressing room has new names on the pegs.

outcomes.text: There's a woollen scarf on the third peg from the door.
Not this year. The scarf's on the seat by the tunnel on Saturday, with the boy in it.
"Kept him on. He wears that scarf to the bus. In August."

beats.hint: A season on, the boy with the scarf
